_meta.description: AI for All exhibit lookup. city -> operations -> {label, showGroups, min/max by CO2}

totals_units.distance_km: km (origin city -> destination data center, great-circle)

_meta.buildingHours_units: hours of that building's operation, by metric (elec/co2/water)
_meta.min_max_note: min = destination with lowest CO2; max = destination with highest CO2. Since the exact data center is unknown, these bound the possible impact.
_meta.showGroups_note: primary + secondary together cover all 8 buildings with no overlap; light up primary by default, secondary as the alternate combination
_meta.building_hourly_rates_note: co2 & water rates are per-city (home grid); electricity is grid-independent
